Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value. Join target_dictionary on assays.tid, compound_structures on activities.molregno, and molecule_dictionary on activities.molregno. Filter to target CHEMBL1821, standard_type IC50, standard_relation '=', and pchembl_value not null. Do not deduplicate; keep every qualifying activity row. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit 1000.
